rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=60, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-5: KNOB=pretrain_epochs 30->60 (2x; KEEP residual_learning=False from iter-3/4, do NOT revert). TRAJECTORY: with the double-residual wiring bug fixed (residual_learning False), score is monotone-increasing in pretrain_epochs: ep8->0.5373 (iter-3, val_psnr 16.3 dB), ep30->0.7459 (iter-4, val_psnr 20.9 dB). The climb has NOT plateaued (still under-trained), so more epochs should keep lifting. Siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729, itnet_v3=0.9683, and the prior itnet_v2 run peaked 0.9714 at ~ep72 -- so the ~0.97 ceiling is reachable purely by epochs. HYPOTHESIS: score is monotone in epochs; ~60 epochs should reach ~0.90+ en route to the ~0.97 sibling/prior-run ceiling, with the k=3 DC step refining the denoiser output. Wall guard: 60 ep ~= 2x iter-4's 258s ~= 520s (<15 min); val_n 8->6 (throughput guard only, not the hypothesis knob) keeps margin.
